module.purpose: Implements the commit-phase side-effect handlers of the React reconciler: mounting/unmounting hook effects, class lifecycles, refs, and profiler callbacks, with dev-time guards and error capture.
module.summary: This module centralises the commit-phase effect orchestration for React's fiber tree. It provides exported functions to mount and unmount layout, insertion, and passive hook effects; invoke class component lifecycles (componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate, getSnapshotBeforeUpdate, componentWillUnmount); attach and detach refs (including view transitions and fragments); and fire profiler onRender/onCommit/onPostCommit hooks. All effect invocations are wrapped in try/catch that routes errors through captureCommitPhaseError, and profiling is conditionally timed via feature flags. Dev builds perform additional prop/state consistency checks and run user code under runWithFiberInDEV.
module.businessContext: Core React rendering pipeline. If these commit effects mis-fire, components fail to mount, refs break, and profiler data is wrong, breaking app correctness and DevTools.

preconditions: current must be a Fiber instance whose .mode property is a numeric bitmask

units.name: commitClassSnapshot

detail.name: commitClassSnapshot
detail.signature: function commitClassSnapshot(finishedWork: Fiber, snapshot: any): void
preconditions: finishedWork must be a Fiber node representing a class component that returned a non-null snapshot from getSnapshotBeforeUpdate.
finishedWork.stateNode must be the component instance (ref current) and must already exist at call time.
postconditions: If a snapshot value is provided, it is assigned to instance.__reactSnapshot$, making it available to subsequent commit-phase callbacks (e.g., componentDidUpdate).
If the snapshot value is null/undefined, no assignment occurs and the instance retains its prior __reactSnapshot$ value unchanged.
invariants: The snapshot assigned is exactly the value passed in from callGetSnapshotBeforeUpdates; no transformation is applied.
This assignment only occurs during the commit phase for fibers that have already rendered a class component with a defined getSnapshotBeforeUpdate lifecycle.
edgeCases: When snapshot is null or undefined, the assignment to instance.__reactSnapshot$ is skipped entirely, preserving any previously stored snapshot.
When finishedWork.stateNode is null or not yet instantiated (should not occur per React's commit invariants), the function returns early without assignment.
The function does not guard against or overwrite prior snapshots if no new snapshot is supplied — only explicit non-null snapshots replace the stored value.
stateMutations: instance.__reactSnapshot$ (the component instance's snapshot property) — mutated only when a non-null snapshot is supplied.
detail.summary: Assigns a captured getSnapshotBeforeUpdate return value to the component instance before the commit phase is finalized, ensuring class components receive their pre-commit DOM snapshot as part of the commit contract.

units.name: commitAttachRef

detail.name: commitAttachRef
detail.signature: function commitAttachRef(finishedWork: Fiber): void
preconditions: finishedWork is a committed Fiber on which the ref attach step is being applied.
If run in a non-DEV build, runWithFiberInDEV is not used; behavior is the same in DEV and prod aside from extra checks.
postconditions: If finishedWork.ref was null on entry, no ref is attached and getPublicInstance is not consulted.
If finishedWork.ref is a function, it is invoked exactly once with the public instance (or null).
If finishedWork.ref is an object ref, its current field is set to the public instance (or null).
invariants: A ref is attached at most once per commit for a given fiber.
The attached value is derived from getPublicInstance(finishedWork.stateNode), never from finishedWork.stateNode directly.
edgeCases: finishedWork.ref is null: function returns immediately without reading stateNode or invoking getPublicInstance.
Object ref (RefObject with a current field) and a host/instance stateNode: ref.current is set to the public instance returned by getPublicInstance.
Function ref: the ref callback is invoked with the public instance and any return value is not stored by this function.
getPublicInstance returns null (e.g. stateNode has no public instance): object ref.current is set to null and the function ref is invoked with null rather than throwing.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: A null ref is treated as a valid no-op; a missing/empty ref is never reported as an error here.

stateMutations: Sets forwardedRef.current on the fiber's object ref to the public instance (or null).
Invokes the fiber's function ref with the public instance (or null), which may itself mutate ref target state.
detail.summary: Attaches a fiber's ref to the public instance of its committed stateNode during the commit phase, invoking function refs with the instance and setting object refs' current field, and is a no-op when no ref is present.

specTests.then: getPublicInstance is never consulted and the function returns without mutating any ref
the function ref is invoked exactly once with that public instance
the object ref's current field is set to that public instance

detail.signature: function safelyAttachRef(fiber: Fiber, componentNode: ComponentElement | null): void
